body: Both sides file their picks on Saturday morning and they go public straight after the lock, so nothing is hidden — there's just nothing filed yet. What we can show you now is every price we've checked: 32 sides across the 16 games TAB has up. None of them has cleared the +4% bar.

callout.kicker: Why nothing has been bet yet
callout.body: TAB's cut on these games is 4.28–5.90%; the US books work on 2–3%. So every bet here starts behind before we've even looked at the two teams. The one advantage we can find is a price TAB hasn't got around to updating.

panels.body: The US books post 54.5 and TAB posts 55, so TAB's number is half a point above the US number, which sits with the under. On price, both sides are short of the true one — the over by 1.52%, the under by 7.43%.
